La cocina, aunque es un poco pequeña, tiene de todo para poder cocinar lo que se quiera, y con una gran disposición de vajilla, cubiertos y electrodomésticos. Se agradece el detalle de bienvenida de las cápsulas para el café, el vino y el snack! Tiene barbacoa. El tener una terraza delantera y un patio trasero da mucho juego a la hora de comer en el exterior. El jardín también está muy cuidado. La situación de la casa para poder pasear por diferentes playas sin utilizar el coche es perfecta. La zona es muy tranquila. Por poner una pega faltaría un armario o balda para poner la ropa en dos de las habitaciones, aunque en la tercera hay un armario fabuloso. La ropa de cama y las toallas estupendas. Hemos disfrutado de una semana maravillosa en familia!!
Nous avons passé un super séjour.Tout était impeccable comme sur la description de l’annonce.nous recommandons fortement cette location !

invictus-escape-jacuzzi-charm-in-the-cit.text: Nice place to relax. Easy to get Ubers from as well
Good location, nice terrace and jacuzzi. Very convenient to relax after your visit!

The apartment was easy to find, well equipped and beautifully decorated and furnished. It was immaculately clean too. The outdoor space was fabulous, and the hot tub is a great addition. However, the weather was so hot when we visited we didn't use the hot tub! The apartment is a little bit out of the way from the hustle and bustle which has pros and cons. It's very peaceful, feels safe, and the neighbourhood has everything you need. There are nice bars and restaurants a little walk away, and the busiest areas with the shops and bars are about a 15-20 minute walk away towards the river. Overall this is a perfect, spacious apartment in Porto and equipped us with everything we needed.
We really enjoyed our stay in Porto. The property was very clean and everything was walkable. Easy to find and self check in was great as our flight was delayed. Would recommend staying here in Porto
This was a really great location, plenty of amenities with a lively patio area! great value for money - would recommend
Melhor alojamento local no centro do Porto, calmo, cumpre tudo o que promete! Voltaremos sem dúvida !

Logement parfait. Tout y est : accessoires de cuisine, condiments, eau fraîche préparée d'avance au frigo, jaccuzi opérationnel, shampooing et gel douche, etc. Tout est bien agencé, pratique, joli et calme ! Emplacement parfait, parking dans la rue (soit en stationnement en créneau, soit dans un parking sous-terrain), à produire centre ville (15min à pieds) et de très bons restaurants (directement dans la rue ou dans les rues voisines). Personnel très réactif à toute heure de la semaine et du weekend en cas de problème. Pour les activités proposées, le tour en vélo est excellent (peut être juste revoir le confort des selles qui peut faire toute la difficulté sur un parcours de 2h dans des rues pavées) et le massage à domicile permet une déconnexion totale.
Our stay in this apartment was excellent! The apartment was nice and cozy. Also, the jacuzzi is a great addition to the house, perfect after a long day of walking the hills of beautiful Porto!

A lovely little apartment, central to the city centre but still quiet enough to suit a family stay. Nice little living space with a full kitchen, seating and table and a spacious outside area with hot tub. Clean facilities with a good number of accessories e.g washing machine, coffee machine, toaster, microwave and oven as well as free wi-fi and tv set up. The location is really nice as it wasn't far to walk into the busy areas of the city, there are a couple of supermarkets, a bakery and restaurants all in instant walking distance. We were also able to get takeaway food delivered with ease. We didn't find any instructions for the hot tub but it seemed pretty easy to work out how to set it all up and you felt secluded when in it despite there being buildings near by. We had some slight noise from the apartments above but nothing too upsetting as our young children slept through it. Overall, a lovely little place for families or couples alike when visiting the city.

What a lovely location! Very calm and in the middle of everything! The team was very helpful and responsive! Highly appreciated! The jacuzzi is a great addition to the already awesome place! Thanks for everything! We will be back !

The apartment was in a quiet area of Porto, but the hustle and bustle was only a five minute walk away. Fab little apartment, clean and well equipped. Good powerful shower, however the water didn’t drain very fast. Small, well equipped kitchen, could have done with a draining board for washing up. Comfortable beds. One of the upstairs bed was quite squeaky though so every time my daughter rolled over in bed the whole house heard it. Could also hear the apartment above us as they walked around and moved furniture. Overall a great place to stay whilst visiting Porto! Would recommend!

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans ce logement plein de charme et d’authenticité, en plein cœur de Porto. L’emplacement est idéal : à deux pas des commerces, des restaurants et des bars, ce qui permet de profiter pleinement de la ville tout en ayant tout à portée de main. L’appartement est très agréable et correspond parfaitement à l’esprit de Porto, avec beaucoup de caractère. Mention spéciale pour le jacuzzi, un vrai plus après une journée de visites, avec des instructions claires et faciles à suivre à distance. La communication avec les hôtes a été simple, rapide et chaleureuse, ce qui a rendu le séjour encore plus fluide. Nous recommandons vivement ce logement pour découvrir Porto dans les meilleures conditions !

portugal-active-bandeira-retreat-7f5428.text: El alojamiento es precioso, tranquilo, está impecable. Perfecto para grupos familiares. Tuvimos un pequeño problema con el funcionamiento de la caldera pero lo solucionaron de forma rápida. La atención de los hosts ha sido sobresaliente. Recomiendo al 100%

Casa muito catita, espaçosa e bem localizada. Mal chegamos estava a casa limpíssima e com um bom cheiro. Anfitrião respondia muito rápido as mensagens e era esclarecedor. Apenas aponto uma coisa que é o facto de que a internet por vezes não funcionava
Logement spacieux avec accès aux commerces à proximité, le centre se trouve à 15min à pieds. Très bon séjour en famille.

The house is very nice! There is plenty of space for everyone, and it is not cold inside. There is a beautiful small courtyard with grapevines. The hot water pressure in the bathroom is good. The beds are large. The kitchen was well-equipped, which made cooking convenient. Thoughtfully, there were enough capsules for the dishwasher and washing machine. The only downside is that the house is next to the road, which made it a little noisy to sleep. Otherwise, the house is wonderful.

A casa é maior e mais espaçosa, parece que as fotos são mais modestas. O anfitrião é excelente e responde rápido. Localização da casa é fantástica, farmácia, mercado, cafés e parque infantil a poucos passos de distância. Paragem de autocarro bem na porta. A única coisa que eu acrescentaria/mudaria, e que comuniquei ao anfitrião, o frigorífico da cozinha é antigo e pequeno, não gela direito se tem muita coisa, e falta também um frigorífico e utensílios de cozinha na parte de baixo da casa para não subir as escadas a cada pouco.
It should be noted that while parking is free, it’s in neighbourhood streets. Sometimes it takes several rounds to find a spot!
Casa em perfeitas condições conforme o anúncio. Anfitrião muito prestável e simpático. Nada a apontar.

lima-river-s-salvador-house-5cef22.text: Sitio tranquilo, amplio y muy acogedor

La Villa esta muy bien montada. Perfecta para grupos grandes En General la impieza y ordenado de todo lo hacia sentir a uno como en casa. Tiene un area de esparcimiento muy agradable para jugar o ver tv. Para familia con ni.os peque;os el parque es muy atractivo. Disfrutamos mucho de la estadia
Alojamento fantástico e pensado ao detalhe. Equipa de apoio muito prestável e resolveu todas as questões colocadas! Serviço 5 ⭐️ Manuel Florida, Estados Unidos
Um excelente fim de semana em família.
très beau logement, conforme à la description. fonctionnel quand on est à 12 personnes.

Tanto la casa como las zonas comunes son perfectas para un viaje en grupo, no faltaba ni un detalle. El único pero que pondríamos es que se escucha demasiado los coches en un par de habitaciones, ya que dan directamente hacia la carretera. Pero en general fue una estancia genial.

Casa grande, equipada con todo y muy cómoda gracias también al número de baños que tiene. Ideal para grupos de amigos con los que disfrutar las zonas comunes. Muy recomendable! Nosotros tuvimos la suerte de estar solos casi todos los días y usar la piscina y jardín de manera privada, pero es compartida con otra pequeña casa de la misma agencia.

Tudo conforme publicitado, casa com todas as condições para passar dias agradáveis. O único ponto negativo é o  isolamento sonoro (ouve-se tudo o que se passa na estrada, o que faz com que se acorde constantemente com o barulho dos carros)

La casa nos encantó !! 😍 Respondía fielmente a la descripción y fotografías. Los espacios muy amplios y bien cuidados, con unas zonas comunes con todo tipo de detalles, muy funcional y cómoda para una estancia por la zona. Fuimos un grupo de 3 familias con 4 niñas adolescentes y todo fue maravilloso. Muy bien equipada, limpia y con unas camas estupendas. Sin duda muy recomendable y seguro q repetiremos..

espaço realmente extraordinário, melhor que o previsto. muito cuidado nas comodidades oferecidas e pormenores pouco usuais como a qualidade das toalhas de banho e roupōes. Cozinha impecável e muito bem equipada. quartos de dimensão superior à normal com excelentes quartos de banho. espaço exterior repleto de pormenores deliciosos, que as curtas estadias não permitem usufruir. foi realmente extraordinário obrigado

abreu-retreat-palace-luxury-elegance-lei.text: Magnifique domaine. Le jardin est exceptionnel, la piscine est immense, et le tennis a été refait récemment. Nous avons passé une superbe semaine à 2 familles. Le village autour n'a pas d'intérêt, mais on l'oublie vite une fois dans le domaine. La cuisine pourrait être mieux équipée et refaite. Il n'y a bizarrement pas de machine à laver...mais c'est bien fait au supermarché à 1mn.
Charming and spacious house with a gorgeous and huge garden. The pool and the tennis court were very good as well. Very quiet area but at walking distance to a big supermarket and to a snack bar.

The property is gorgeous, even more beautiful than the pictures. Really great for a family of 10 people. Well maintained and very high end. The location appears remote on a map but in fact there are amenities all around, Uber is available, and Guimares is close and has lots of entertainment. We didn't mind the location as a trade-off for the size of the property. Host was very responsive, but check in procedure was very annoying, requiring me to obtain selfies with IDs from 10 guests prior to giving me check in information. The house is fairly well equipped and well maintained. Take note that there is no washer. Host offers all kinds of added services, likely daily housekeeping and private chef, but forewarning they are priced very expensive.

We had an amazing stay as a group of 8 adults. The house and grounds were much bigger than even the pictures looked, and it was a perfect place for a large group to stay. Bedrooms were spacious, clean, with blackout shutters for a good nights sleep. The tennis court was great, and they had recently replaced the equipment which a previous review had mentioned was damaged. The location is very private, with a supermarket 2 minutes away. The host was responsive when we contacted them for help/for recommendations. The only comment is there is no washing machine in the house, despite its size, but there are washing machines at the supermarket at the end of the road. We would definitely recommend!
The spacious and charming estate and house. Huge mature trees, large pool, accommodating living space. It was a pleasure.
Great experience, mind-blowing place. The garden & pool make an amazing breath-taking combo, with giant trees and a lot of privacy, and the tennis court is a plus.
Un gran sitio para desconectar , disfrutar de una gran casa con encanto y un jardín y piscina de película.
Estuvimos muy a gusto. La casa es cómoda y muy grande. Destacar que todo estaba extremadamente limpio. La zona de jardín y piscina es muy agradable. Ideal para viaje en grupo de amigos o en familia.

An unforgettable family getaway at Quinta Refúgio Abreu! This place is a true luxury retreat — elegant, spacious, and surrounded by nature. We stayed as a family and couldn’t have asked for more. From the moment we arrived, the Portugal Active team took care of everything with incredible attention to detail. We had a private kitchen and cleaning team throughout our stay, and the service was outstanding — from breakfast to dinner, every meal was fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. The kids loved the pool and the games room, while we enjoyed the peaceful garden, the tennis court, and relaxing in the outdoor lounge. We also booked some of the activities Portugal Active offers — horseback riding and a local food experience — and both were absolutely amazing. This is not just a holiday house, it’s an experience. Highly recommended for families looking for something special and stress-free!

heritage-loft-in-the-cradle-of-portugal-.text: The place was great! Great location and comfortable space

Excellent apartment with nice decoration, located in the historic center with a view for a nice square. Not so easy to find the door due a be in a narrow alley with no number, but once inside was worthy
Perfekt leilighet om du vil bo i sentrum av guimaraes. Helt lik beskrivelsen. Ikke nødvendig med kollektivtransport da det meste ligger ved gåavstand fra leiligheten. Anbefaler👍🏾
Um pequeno apartamento, mas com todas as condições
Espaço limpo e acolhedor, muito bem localizado. Correspondeu às expectativas

A lovely place to stay in the beautiful and historic centre of Guimaräes. The apartment has a well designed and equipped interior. The host responded very quickly to a glitch with the door lock when we arrived.

alentejo-rural-farmhouse-with-pool-and-t.text: Adoramos ficar no Monte, sem dúvida que deu para desconectar e descontrair, o espaço está preparado e equipado com tudo o que precisamos para uns dias.

The house and surrounding area are beautiful and so peaceful. The house itself is lovely, comfortable, and a great place to relax. The pool was amazing and so refreshing during the hot Alentejo days. We really loved our stay and would definitely come back.

Excellent séjour passé avec une autre famille amis dans le Monte de Sossego a Ferreira do Alentejo. Quelle belle maison ,simple , joliment décorée au calme avec toutes les installations nécessaires. Propreté de la maison au top , l équipe de nettoyage était encore sur place a notre arrivée, et ils ont tout fait pour nous mettre a l aise . Chambres spacieuses, lit fraîchement faits , propreté irréprochable. Cuisine super équipée,avec également dans une pièce a part un lave linge et un sèche linge . Piscine non chauffée mais avec les températures de ce mois ci pas nécessaire. Coin barbecue au top avec lave vaisselle intégrée. En bref , magnifique séjour dans cette magnifique maison, ou on s est sentis comme chez nous au calme . Restaurants à +/-15 min de la maison. Idem pour les supermarchés. Portugal active, entreprise au top qui reagit rapidement aux messages/ appels. Merci pour tout 😃

We hebben heerlijk genoten van de rust. Het is een heerlijke optrek en een fijn zwembad met zout. Verwarmde zwembad was echt heerlijk. Groot terrein waar je gewoon lekker van geniet. Schaduw voor de auto om te parkeren was echt perfect. Heerlijk was het om hier te verblijven.

Where to start. I’ve just got home from the most magical holiday in this beautiful villa. We visited Portugal as our friends were getting married. We bought our family and made a week of it. The property was incredible! We all had bedrooms with en-suite’s. The rooms were beautiful. The place was spotless, and we had everything we could possibly need. The kitchen is so well equipped. We also loved the second  living room. We hired a car which is essentially due to the location of the property. This is also important for doing any food shopping and also taking your rubbish to the village (this was super easy to do). We all loved the privacy of the property. We woke late, had coffee on the terrace and then made our way down to the pool later in the day. Dinner back on the terrace and then inside to watch the World Cup in the evening. We had two small issues during our stay, these were fixed promptly with lots of communication from the host. All in all it was a beautiful stay, thank you!

the-nature-princess-by-portugal-active-2.text: una casa espectacular, todo muy limpió y la descripción al detalle, en un sitio muy tranquilo y privacidad absoluta.

Una propiedad fantástica con todos los lujos para pasar unos días en familia o pareja con piscina de uso privado , terreno , jacuzzi , sauna o Gimanasio entre las comodidades que ofrece . Menaje de cocina completo y distribución perfecta para alojarse

This place was absolutely stunning, we felt lucky we found it available. The place had style and felt luxurious, and we immediately felt pampered. The hosts were very kind and accommodating. The sauna (and fireplace) were by far our favorite parts of the stay. It heated up quickly and the entire place felt very clean (including the jacuzzi). The private backyard was gorgeous with the beautiful lemon tree right outside the master bedroom. The kitchen was wonderful for cooking and the bedrooms/bathrooms were huge! Also the beds were comfy. We would LOVE to stay here again.
A casa era simplesmente fantástica com tudo o que necessitamos para ter uns dias relaxantes, o jacuzi era óptimo e a envolvência também!
It's just an amazing house, comfortable and private, we totally recommend it. We will come back for sure

dunes-beach-house-with-ocean-views-cb71c.text: La maison correspondant aux descriptifs, propre, lumineuse, bien agencée…… L’hôte est très agréable et réactif. Nous y avons passé des vacances en famille géniale. Je reviendrai sans hésité. Je recommande à 100%.
Super verblijf gehad. Heerlijk uitgerust en optimaal gebruik gemaakt van het privé zwembad. Alles was super schoon en zoals omschreven in de advertentie. Zeker aan te raden.

Lovely villa, felt like it was quite new, probably was. Had everything we needed and very close to some nice beaches, local cafes/restaurants, little supermarket that serves fresh fish. Nice convenience and certainly good enough. We hired bikes at the sport hotel to get into town and have activities to do, but can also use Bolt or local taxis. Big supermarkets are probably 10-15mins drive. Charging for early or late check out is not something I have ever witnessed but there is a grace of 1 hour for free or risk it until the cleaners come!
Väldigt trevlig villa som hade allt vi önskade. Fina rum och stor öppen planlösning. Grillområdet var ett extra + som förgyllde vistelsen.

alvarinho-villa-5-suites-heated-pool-485.text: Adorámos ficar hospedados nesta casa. A decoração é incrível, a casa muito confortável e espaçosa e o espaço exterior (onde se encontra a piscina) é a melhor parte! Pretendo voltar em breve.

Adoramos a acomodação, tem todas as condições para receber famílias, muito bem equipada desde a cozinha, casas de banho, quartos luxuosos, zona super calma, previlegio de ter contato com a natureza. O Lidl  é algum comércio como cafés, bancos, farmácias e transportes públicos ficam a 6 minutos de carro. As fotos não fazem tanto jus a tamanha beleza, voltaremos de certeza caso nós seja permitido. Super recomendo para famílias inteiras.
Casa otima para passar uma estadia com um grupo de amigos ou familia. Quartos muito confortáveis e espaço exterior excelente.

lumina-duplex-by-portugal-active-2bbb35.text: If you're in Viana do Castello for surfing, wing foiling, or just the beach, this location is perfectly convenient. Walk to the beach and local restaurants. I liked how the apartment is split onto two levels: living and sleeping. Unfortunately, the WiFi didn't extend down to the sleeping level. I'm sure the hosts will fix this.
Zeer mooi appartement, heel mooi ingericht. Het appartement was heel proper. Tussentijds werd er gepoetst en de lakens ververst. Op wandelafstand van het strand. Een echte aanrader!
